Specifications

No specifications yet. These become the product's spec table, and the ones marked filterable become search facets.

Add specification

Facetmarks a spec as filterable, which is what puts it in the storefront's filter sidebar. Products group by key, not by label — two products spelling the label differently still group together if the key matches. Rows with no key or no value are dropped on save.

Images

Images are added after the first save. An upload is filed under the product it belongs to, so the product has to exist first.
